name: translate-bridge
description: Write to Claude in your own language: prompts go to Claude in English, and replies and step labels are shown in your language beside the English. Uses any OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek by default), with fallback providers.

language.title: Your language
language.description: The language you write in and want replies shown in, named in English: Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, ...

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Key for the translation API. Left empty, the TRANSLATE_BRIDGE_API_KEY environment variable is used.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that translates. Left empty with DeepSeek, deepseek-flash is used.

extraBody.title: Extra request fields (JSON)
extraBody.description: Optional JSON object merged into every request, such as {"temperature": 0}.

fallback.title: Fallback providers
fallback.description: Providers tried in order when the one before fails, comma-separated: deepseek, zhipu, qwen, openai, openrouter, ollama.

models.title: Model per provider
models.description: Models for named providers, such as qwen=qwen-flash, ollama=qwen3:8b. DeepSeek and Zhipu have defaults; the others need one.

deepseekApiKey.title: DeepSeek API key
deepseekApiKey.description: Key used when deepseek is a fallback or picked with /translate provider. Left empty, the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable is used.

zhipuApiKey.title: Zhipu (GLM) API key
zhipuApiKey.description: Key used when zhipu is a fallback or picked with /translate provider. Left empty, the ZHIPU_API_KEY environment variable is used.

qwenApiKey.title: Qwen (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) API key
qwenApiKey.description: Key used when qwen is a fallback or picked with /translate provider. Left empty, the DASHSCOPE_API_KEY environment variable is used.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Key used when openai is a fallback or picked with /translate provider. Left empty, the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable is used.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Key used when openrouter is a fallback or picked with /translate provider. Left empty, the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable is used.
